import numpy as np, json
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def comps(g,band=3):
    g=np.array(g); h,w=g.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(g,dtype=bool); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r,c]==band: continue
            if seen[r,c] or g[r,c]==0: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; cells=set()
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop()
                if (a,b) in cells: continue
                cells.add((a,b))
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+dr,b+dc
                    if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and g[na,nb]!=band and g[na,nb]!=0 and (na,nb) not in cells:
                        stack.append((na,nb))
            out.append(cells)
    return out
for key in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=np.array(G[key+' input']); go=np.array(G[key+' output'])
    cs=comps(gi)
    bandcells=set(zip(*np.where(gi==3)))
    print(key,'ncomps',len(cs),'sizes',[len(c) for c in sorted([tuple(sorted(c)) for c in cs])])

    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [c for c in range(W) if set(g[r][c] for r in range(H))!={bg} and len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(H)))==1],bg
for name,(i,o) in [('1',(d1i,d1o)),('2',(d2i,d2o)),('3',(d3i,d3o))]:
    print(name,vbands(i),'->',vbands(o))
